newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish lower in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. debt futures ended a quiet afternoon lower, under pressure most of the day from followthrough weakness from Friday's sell-off.
September Treasury bond futures slipped to a two-week low early at 114-12/32, but light short-covering lifted sluggish September to mid-range into the close, traders said.
"All the action was this morning," said John Kadich, bond futures analyst with Dean Witter Futures.
Technically, the market backed up and filled single price prints on market profile left over from the first day of Humphrey-Hawkins testimony at 114-15/32 to 114-22/32, he said.
"We filled in those, but it was well-bid down there," Kadich said. "We just filled in some value at the low-volume area and tomorrow we'll start waiting for the refunding," he said.

Treasury begins its quarterly refunding on Tuesday, with an auction of $16.0 billion in three-year notes. Treasury auctions $12.0 billion in 10-year notes on Wednesday and $10.0 billion in bonds on Thursday.
"A lot of people are expecting these auctions to go pretty well," a Eurodollar trader said. "I think today wasn't as much worry about the auction as it was followthrough from Friday."
Kadich pegged support in September T-bonds at 114-8/32 to 10/32. Others put more support at 114-3/32 and 114-00.
The Euro trader said the day's low in Sept T-bonds at 114-12/32 could be near-term support now.
"You made that low at 12 and didn't see a lot of followthrough from here," he said.
He said the short end was in the grips of more negative momentum.
"It's negative until 11 (94.11) in the Dec and 02 (94.02) in the March," the trader said. "You have to close above those levels to get even neutral," he said.

Debt futures showed scant reaction to June construction spending, which fell 1.1 percent compared with an upwardly revised 0.3-percent gain in May. The June forecast had been for a 1.1-percent increase.

At the close, September T-bonds were down 5/32 to 114-21/32, notes fell 4/32 to 109-24/32, munis fell 2/32 to 120-14/32, Dec bills lost 0.025 to 94.775, Eurodollars fell 0.020 to 94.090. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
